subject.title: fix(memory): keep shared QMD manager alive on active-memory recall timeout

question: Should this PR's optional closeActiveMemorySearchManager scope and releaseMemoryIndexManagers runtime hook become the accepted memory lifecycle contract for active-memory timeout cleanup?
rationale: Code review can verify the mechanics, but Plugin SDK and memory runtime lifecycle semantics are compatibility-sensitive and require maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept Scoped Lifecycle Contract
options.body: After the branch is refreshed, merge this shape so active-memory can release disposable index managers without retiring the shared QMD manager.

options.title: Keep The Contract Internal
options.body: Ask for a rewrite that fixes memory-core's active-memory cleanup without adding a plugin-facing optional scope or runtime hook.

options.title: Defer To Broader Memory Reliability Work
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the narrow bug fixed only as part of the broader active-memory/QMD reliability redesign.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Lifecycle Contract
recommendation.body: After the branch is refreshed, merge this shape so active-memory can release disposable index managers without retiring the shared QMD manager.

likelyOwner.reason: They are recorded as the approval/automerge signal for the merged cleanup work whose lifecycle contract this PR narrows.
